title: the reason of a denied worker start tells the agent to launch with --build <id>, not --preset
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D6 (the launch flag is --build); TS-ODDITIES H2 (the deny text names the launcher)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-10, build vocabulary; docs/decisions.md D6). A direct worker start is denied, and the reason names the replacement launch command with the flag `--build <id>`; it never names `--preset`. The oracle guard still says `Use: bun run jitso launch --preset <id> --brief <file> ...`, so both reason expectations FAIL on TS. The hook input is not translated by the ts adapter.

tool_input.command: orca orchestration worker-start --run r1 --task t1 --terminal term_1
